description: This file defines a web page class for an online examination system. It includes event handlers for page load, navigation buttons, course and semester selection, and database operations for adding questions and exams related to theory courses.

classes.name: TheorySet
classes.description: Partial class representing the web page for managing theory questions and exam details within the online examination system.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles the page load event, currently with commented-out code.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Transfers user to the AdminPanel page.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Transfers user to the AdminQueue page.

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Transfers user to the AdminLeaderboard page.

methods.name: selectB_Click
methods.description: Populates course dropdown based on selected semester.

methods.name: AddQB_Click
methods.description: Inserts a new question into the theoryQS database table and updates question numbering.

methods.name: setB_Click
methods.description: Creates a new exam record for the selected course.

methods.name: clearB_Click
methods.description: Clears input text boxes for question options and marks.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Logs out the user by redirecting to the login page.

methods.name: selectSemesterDropDownList_SelectedIndexChanged
methods.description: Updates the course dropdown based on the selected semester.

methods.name: SelectCourseDropDownList_SelectedIndexChanged
methods.description: Automatically updates the question number based on the selected course.
